# Import seurat object, subset nkcellscytes and within that, separate aparasitemic and parasitemic nkcellscytes

```{r read in data, include=TRUE}

refmap.atac <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/Multiome/exvivo integrated object/filtered_version_of_harmonyintegrated refmapped not downsampled multiome onject.rds")

nkcells <- subset(refmap.atac, subset=predicted.celltype.l1 == "NK")

# subset apara and para

apara <- subset(nkcells, subset = class == "aparasitemic")

para <- subset(nkcells, subset = class == "parasitemic")

```

# re-cluster and identify nearest neighbors

```{r}
DefaultAssay(apara) <- "RNA"

apara_reclustered <- apara %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize",scale.factor = 10000, verbose = T)  %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = T) %>%
  ScaleData() %>% 
  RunPCA(npc=30) %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims=1:10) # keeping 30 since even up to 20 dims have have more tha 3 SD

apara_reclustered<-FindNeighbors(apara_reclustered,
                                  return.neighbor=TRUE)

apara_cellKNN.mat <- apara_reclustered@neighbors$RNA.nn@nn.dist

rownames(apara_cellKNN.mat) <-  apara_reclustered@neighbors$RNA.nn@cell.names
```

# Convert subsetted objects to summariedExperiments

```{r convert seurat to sce, include=TRUE, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=4}

########################## nk nkcells all ##########################

# check default assay to ATAC
DefaultAssay(nkcells) <- "ATAC"

# Directly convert seurat obejct
nk.se <- seurat_to_se(nkcells, as_sce = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)

# examine rowRanges of se object
rowRanges(nk.se)

# if it shows that Ranges and metadata are zero, manuualy add GRanges from seurat object

rowRanges(nk.se) <- granges(nkcells, use.names = T, use.mcols = F)

########################### apara nkcells ##########################

# convert default assay to ATAC
DefaultAssay(apara) <- "ATAC"

# Directly convert seurat obejct
apara.se <- seurat_to_se(apara, as_sce = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)

# examine rowRanges of se object
rowRanges(apara.se)

# if it shows that Ranges and metadata are zero, manuualy add GRanges from seurat object

rowRanges(apara.se) <- granges(apara, use.names = T, use.mcols = F)

########################### para nkcells ##########################

# convert default assay to ATAC
DefaultAssay(para) <- "ATAC"

# Directly convert seurat obejct
para.se <- seurat_to_se(para, as_sce = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)

# examine rowRanges of se object
rowRanges(para.se)

# if it shows that Ranges and metadata are zero, manuualy add GRanges from seurat object

rowRanges(para.se) <- granges(para, use.names = T, use.mcols = F)
```


```{r}
gr <- granges(apara.se)
seq_keep <- seqnames(gr) %in% GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38) 
seq_keep <- as.vector(seq_keep)
feat.keep <- GRangesToString(grange = gr[seq_keep])
apara.se[['ATAC']] <- subset(apara.se[["ATAC"]], features = feat.keep)
```

# FigR for aparasitemic nkcellscytes


### Run FigR correlations

```{r run FigR corrs for apara, include=TRUE}

# extract RNA_matrix
apara_rna_matrix <- apara[["RNA"]]$data

# remove all genes that have zero expression in all cells
apara_rna_matrix <- apara_rna_matrix[Matrix::rowSums(apara_rna_matrix)!=0,]


cisCor_apara <- runGenePeakcorr(ATAC.se = apara.se,
                           RNAmat = apara_rna_matrix,
                           genome = "hg38", # Also supports mm10 and hg38
                           nCores = 4, 
                           p.cut=NULL)

######################  parasitemic ####################################

```

## evaluate correlation results

```{r evaluate correlation results, include=TRUE, fig.height=9, fig.width=8, fig.align='center'}

# Filter peak-gene correlations by p-value                    
cisCor.filt_apara <- cisCor_apara %>%  
  mutate(pvalZ.adj = p.adjust(pvalZ, method = "holm")) %>%
  mutate(neglog10_padj = -log10(pvalZ.adj+0.0000000001)) %>% #add a very small prior to avoid taking log of 1
  dplyr::filter(neglog10_padj > 0.7)

# Determine DORC genes and plot
dorcGenes_apara <- cisCor.filt_apara %>% 
  dorcJPlot(cutoff=4, 
            labelTop = 10,
            returnGeneList = TRUE)

# Get DORC scores
dorcMat_apara <- getDORCScores(apara.se,
                               dorcTab=cisCor.filt_apara,
                               geneList=dorcGenes_apara,
                               nCores=4)

numDorcs_apara <- cisCor.filt_apara %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  tally() %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```


## Evlaute smoothed cormat and RNA mat (with neighbors)

```{r smooth RNA mat and correlation matrices using nn calcualtions, include=TRUE}
# smooth the correlation using paired cell KNNs

dorcMat.smooth_apara <- smoothScoresNN(
  NNmat=apara_cellKNN.mat,
  mat=dorcMat_apara,
  nCores=4)

# smooth the RNA matrix using paired cell KNNs
RNAmat.smooth_apara <- smoothScoresNN(NNmat = apara_cellKNN.mat,
                           mat = apara_rna_matrix,
                           nCores = 4)
```

## Run FigR 

```{r run FigR, include=TRUE}
# run FigR
fig.d_apara <- runFigRGRN(
  ATAC.se = apara.se,
  rnaMat=RNAmat.smooth_apara, 
                    dorcMat=dorcMat.smooth_apara,
                    dorcTab=cisCor.filt_apara,
                    genome="hg38",
                    dorcGenes=dorcGenes_apara,
                    nCores=4)

require(ggplot2)
require(ggrastr)
require(BuenColors) # https://github.com/caleblareau/BuenColors

spread <- fig.d_apara %>% ggplot(aes(Corr.log10P,Enrichment.log10P,color=Score)) +
          geom_point_rast(size=0.01,shape=16) + 
          theme_classic() +
          scale_color_viridis_b(limits=c(-4,4),oob = scales::squish)

spread
```

```{r , fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=4}
cisCor_apara_barplot <- cisCor_apara %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, rObs, pvalZ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(pvalZ.adj = p.adjust(pvalZ, method = "holm")) %>%
  mutate(neglog10_padj = -log10(pvalZ.adj+0.0000000001)) %>% #add a very small prior to avoid taking log of 1
  dplyr::filter(neglog10_padj > 2) %>%
  slice_max(., rObs, n = 25) %>% #take top 25 ordered by -log10(p.adj)
  mutate(Gene = ifelse(Gene=="CXCR6" & rObs == 1, "CXCR6_Peak1", Gene)) %>%
  mutate(Gene = ifelse(Gene=="CXCR6", "CXCR6_Peak2", Gene)) %>%
   mutate(Gene = ifelse(Gene=="TCL1A" & rObs > 0.6, "TCL1A_Peak1", Gene)) %>%
  mutate(Gene = ifelse(Gene=="TCL1A", "TCL1A_Peak2", Gene)) %>%
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, rObs)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = rObs)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Gene, fill = neglog10_padj)) +
  xlab("r, observed gene-peak corr") +
  ylab("gene") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()

cisCor_apara_barplot
```

# parasitemic nkcellscytes

### Run FigR correlations

```{r run FigR corrs for para, include=TRUE}

# extract RNA_matrix
para_rna_matrix <- para[["RNA"]]$data

# remove all genes that have zero expression in all cells
para_rna_matrix <- para_rna_matrix[Matrix::rowSums(para_rna_matrix)!=0,]


cisCor_para <- runGenePeakcorr(ATAC.se = para.se,
                                RNAmat = para_rna_matrix,
                                genome = "hg38", # Also supports mm10 and hg38
                                nCores = 4, 
                                p.cut=NULL)

######################  parasitemic ####################################

```


```{r , fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=4}
cisCor_para_barplot <- cisCor_para %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, rObs, pvalZ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(pvalZ.adj = p.adjust(pvalZ, method = "holm")) %>%
  mutate(neglog10_padj = -log10(pvalZ.adj+0.0000000001)) %>% #add a very small prior to avoid taking log of 1
  dplyr::filter(neglog10_padj > 2) %>%
  slice_max(., rObs, n = 25) %>% #take top 25 ordered by -log10(p.adj)
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, rObs)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = rObs)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Gene, fill = neglog10_padj)) +
  xlab("r, observed gene-peak corr") +
  ylab("gene") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()

cisCor_para_barplot
```
## evaluate correlation results

```{r evaluate correlation results, include=TRUE, fig.height=9, fig.width=8}

# Filter peak-gene correlations by p-value                    
cisCor.filt_para <- cisCor_para %>% 
  filter(pvalZ <= 0.05)

# Determine DORC genes and plot
dorcGenes_para <- cisCor.filt_para %>% 
  dorcJPlot(cutoff=6, 
            labelTop = 20,
            returnGeneList = TRUE)

# Get DORC scores
dorcMat_para <- getDORCScores(para.se,
                               dorcTab=cisCor.filt_para,
                               geneList=dorcGenes_para,
                               nCores=4)

numDorcs_para <- cisCor.filt_para %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  tally() %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

## to get cellKNN matrices, re-reduce seurat object and save neighbors

```{r find nearest neighbours in parasitemic cells by reclustering, include=TRUE}

DefaultAssay(para) <- "RNA"

para_reclustered <- para %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize",scale.factor = 10000, verbose = T)  %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = T) %>%
  ScaleData() %>% 
  RunPCA(npc=30) %>% 
  RunUMAP(dims=1:10) # keeping 30 since even up to 20 dims have have more tha 3 SD

para_reclustered<-FindNeighbors(para_reclustered,
                                 return.neighbor=TRUE)

para_cellKNN.mat <- para_reclustered@neighbors$RNA.nn@nn.dist

rownames(para_cellKNN.mat) <-  para_reclustered@neighbors$RNA.nn@cell.names

```

## Evlaute smoothed cormat and RNA mat (with neighbors)

```{r smooth RNA mat and correlation matrices using nn calcualtions, include=TRUE}
# smooth the correlation using paired cell KNNs

dorcMat.smooth_para <- smoothScoresNN(
  NNmat=para_cellKNN.mat,
  mat=dorcMat_para,
  nCores=4)

# smooth the RNA matrix using paired cell KNNs
RNAmat.smooth_para <- smoothScoresNN(NNmat = para_cellKNN.mat,
                                      mat = para_rna_matrix,
                                      nCores = 4)
```

## Run FigR 

```{r run FigR, include=TRUE}
# run FigR
fig.d_para <- runFigRGRN(
  ATAC.se = para.se,
  rnaMat=RNAmat.smooth_para, 
  dorcMat=dorcMat.smooth_para,
  dorcTab=cisCor.filt_para,
  genome="hg38",
  dorcGenes=dorcGenes_para,
  nCores=4)

require(ggplot2)
require(ggrastr)
require(BuenColors) # https://github.com/caleblareau/BuenColors

spread_para <- fig.d_para %>% ggplot(aes(Corr.log10P,Enrichment.log10P,color=Score)) +
          geom_point_rast(size=0.01,shape=16) + 
          theme_classic() +
          scale_color_viridis_b(limits=c(-4,4),oob = scales::squish)

spread_para
```

# save FigR results
```{r}
saveRDS(fig.d_apara, "aparasitemic nk nkcellscytes figr results_notdownsampled_obj.rds")
saveRDS(cisCor_apara, "aparasitemic nk nkcellscytes gene peak correlations using figr results_notdownsampled_obj.rds")

saveRDS(fig.d_para, "parasitemic nk nkcellscytes figr results_notdownsampled_obj.rds")
saveRDS(cisCor_para, "parasitemic nk nkcellscytes gene peak correlations using figr results_notdownsampled_obj.rds")
```
